description: Search GPU machines you can rent now at live prices: B300, B200, H200, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, H100 and more. Free; changes nothing. Use it before rent_gpu and to answer what a GPU costs right now. Rows come best first: what the GPU can do (capability, H100 = 1.0), its price and how reliable its host is, with badges saying why (Reliable host, NVLink, or a warning such as a host taking it back soon); sort=price lists the cheapest first. pick is the first row with the reason, cheapest the lowest whole-machine price. Each row has node_id (for rent_gpu), gpu, gpu_count (rent_gpu rents all of them unless gpu_count says fewer; max_gpus 1 finds single-GPU machines), vram_gb per GPU, price_per_gpu_hour_usd, price_per_hour_usd for the whole machine, CPUs (and cpu, the model), RAM, disk, location, tier and network. Badges also say when renters rate a host low, it often fails to start or its GPUs are slow next to the same GPU elsewhere. Tiers: on_demand runs until its removal time; spot costs less but its host can take it back at any time, so use it only for work that saves checkpoints off the machine. Prices can move within a minute: pass the row's price to rent_gpu as max_price_per_gpu_hour. For multi-machine training add min_nic_gbps 400 and min_nics_per_gpu 1; null network fields were not reported.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US or DE.

gpudirect_rdma.description: true: only machines whose market reports GPUDirect RDMA.

max_gpus.description: Only machines with at most this many GPUs; 1 for a single-GPU job.

max_price_per_gpu_hour.description: Price ceiling in USD per GPU-hour.

min_gpus.description: Only machines with at least this many GPUs.

min_nic_gbps.description: RDMA NICs at least this fast, Gb/s (400, 800).

min_nics_per_gpu.description: RDMA NICs per GPU; 1 = one NIC per GPU.

min_vram_gb.description: Only GPUs with at least this much memory each.

sort.description: recommended (default), price (cheapest first), value (capability per dollar on a trusted host) or capability (fastest GPU first).

name: search_gpus
title: Search GPUs
